mapping_reviews.reason: Article 5(4) of DORA requires members of the management body to have sufficient knowledge of ICT risk and digital operational resilience, which directly supports the control's objective of providing training on these topics. The provision does not specify a uniform number of sessions or hours, aligning with the control statement.

applicability_note: No additional applicability conditions are known.
